description: The Master-signed model/memory endpoint directory. It is metadata, never knowledge or authority.

nodes.models: logical aliases and local endpoint kinds
nodes.memory: local router endpoint and owner scopes

rules: No secrets, prompts, vault pages, memory records or authority material.
Routers treat a missing/stale directory as unavailable and fall back to their static local map.
The directory cannot widen a capability or a vault scope.
